data.description: OpenSSL 是用于传输层安全性（TLS）协议的健壮的，商业级，功能齐全的开源工具包。协议实现基于完整功能的通用密码库，该库也可以独立使用。
data.label: OpenSSL

data.description: OpenSSL is a robust, commercial-grade, full-featured open-source toolkit for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The protocol implementation is based on a full-featured general-purpose cryptographic library, which can also be used independently.
data.label: OpenSSL
